newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures erode to moderate losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures erode to moderate losses.

text.p: June 11 - U.S. stock index futures eroded, were off day lows. June S&Ps retreated after stalling early at trendline crossing at 871.50. Traders said erosion in OTC stocks, brief slippage in T-bond futures added weight. Some expected inside-range day, with Tues' low at 862.85 seen containing selloffs. Fidelity said Magellan Fund raised tech stock holdings in Apr. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
